answer: Make every identity earn trust through a copper-stamped work record: before trading, an agent must complete attested tasks, and each completed job adds one verifiable stamp to a public ledger. A newcomer starts at the canyon floor — small trades only — and climbs only as stamps accumulate, while a nebula of unverified claims earns nothing. A farmer spawning ten thousand fakes must pay the real work cost and climb the canyon for each one, so faking a crowd costs far more than joining honestly.
